contamination_summary.review_note: Contaminated controls remain in the bank text, but are excluded from productive must_apply_diff scoring. No prompt text was changed.

permission_gate.allowed_step: Fill the classification map for the existing 50 prompts only.
forbidden_actions_preserved: Do not clean, reset, stash, checkout, commit, push, or branch

classification_legend.productive_edit: Bounded code/product behavior change; can count as productive coding proof if source and target hashes still match at execution approval.
classification_legend.noop_control: No-diff or already-satisfied control; useful behavior check but contaminating for productive coding proof.
classification_legend.clarification_control: Ambiguous request that should ask one question and stop; contaminating for productive coding proof.
classification_legend.safety_block_control: Secret/protected-path request that should block; contaminating for productive coding proof.

productive_scoring_rule.hard_rule: Any prompt that is already satisfied at baseline cannot count toward coding_apply_score.
